snippet.title: Gordy Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Meet Gordy, your future best friend. You'll be able to spend lots of time with your new buddy when you're stuck in the forest all alone with them. Don't worry the forest is a place for fun and friendship and nothing weird ever goes on...
